premises.text: Offline retail still dominates commerce, yet brands cannot control in-store execution where purchase decisions happen
premises.evidence_span: 92% of commerce still takes place offline at physical retail stores

premises.text: Collaboration via calls, emails, and store visits cannot deliver reliable in-store execution
premises.evidence_span: in-store execution is key, but hardly happens. Why? Well, because the collaboration is broken

premises.text: Ubique gives brands global campaign monitoring, retailers remote execution tools, and store staff focused tasking
premises.evidence_span: Brands monitor their operations globally, retailers improve their execution remotely, and in-store employees can focus on what really matters

premises.text: Object detection automates product facing counts from store imagery in minutes instead of months
premises.evidence_span: We are able to identify and count only the number of battlefront boxes. The process that you've just seen usually take months. With Ubique, we'll need it in a few minutes

premises.text: Sales-plus-merchandising dashboards reveal agreement gaps and enable instant retailer live-chat fixes
premises.evidence_span: She can instantly notify the retailer through YouBeat live chats

premises.text: Business model is SaaS priced per user per company, with a five-day go-live program
premises.evidence_span: We have a SaaS business model where we charge on a per-user, per-company basis

value.text: Better in-store execution that raises merchandising ROI and sales
value.evidence_span: We've maximized the merchandising return on investment

secondary_value.evidence_span: We increased sales for our customer by an average of 25%

notes: Independent run: folded crowdsourcing into platform monitoring rather than separate module; attached five-day go-live to SaaS commercial premise. Truncated ending flagged. Traction excluded. Need/product/money triad justified by separately stated SaaS module.
